# camundacluster_mapping_rule (Resource)

A Camunda cluster mapping rule

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "camundacluster_mapping_rule" "admin" {
  claim_name  = "groups"
  claim_value = "admin"
  name        = "Admin Mapping"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `claim_name` (String) The name of the claim to map.
- `claim_value` (String) The value of the claim to map.
- `name` (String) The name of the mapping rule.

### Read-Only

- `mapping_rule_id` (String) The unique ID of the mapping rule, generated by the server.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# mapping_rule_id is generated by the server on creation, so it must be
# looked up (e.g. via the API or the Camunda Console) before it can be
# imported.
terraform import camundacluster_mapping_rule.admin "2251799813685251"
```
